description: ``roles/<slug>.role.yaml``: a persona applied to every turn it is assigned to.

id.description: Stable identity linking this file to its run history. Never change it; renaming or moving the file keeps the history as long as the id stays.

name.description: How agents, workflows, topics and chats refer to this role. Matched case-insensitively and unique across the folder. Renaming it leaves whatever names it by the old name on the default role.

description.description: One line on what the persona is for.

prompt.description: The system prompt injected into every turn while the role is assigned. May reference skills (`/rewrite`). Empty injects nothing.

title: Precursor assistant role
